text:
anna_csm: Quick heads-up — Meridian QBR scheduled Tue 2026-04-12 10:00am PT. Need final slides, renewal risk summary, enablement ask, and exec talking points. Who can own each piece?

mike_cs: I can do renewal risk + health slide. Will pull usage/latency trends.

tara_ae: I’ll draft the exec talking points and the one-slide ROI summary. @anna_csm can you share the latest renewal cadence?

anna_csm: Renewal cadence is EBR in May, decision window late May. For QBR we want to surface blockers that could move renewal to red. High-level ask: confirm top 3 risks and mitigation per risk.

raj_solutions: I’ll own the enablement plan + adoption checklist. I have a short demo clip of the new dedicated routing we can embed.

lydia_product: I can add the product roadmap slide and note any upcoming compatibility changes that affect Meridian (quantization profile update).

ops-bot: Reminder set for Tue 2026-04-10 09:00am PT — 48h slide freeze for Meridian QBR.

mike_cs: Draft plan:
```
- Slide 1: Account headline + NPS
- Slide 2: Usage & latency trend (last 90d)
- Slide 3: Top 3 risks + owner & mitigation
- Slide 4: Enablement plan + adoption checklist (Raj)
- Slide 5: Product roadmap impact (Lydia)
- Slide 6: Exec asks + renewal timeline (Tara)
```

anna_csm: Perfect. Quick asks: 1) Mike — can you include per-route token cost delta for the last month? 2) Raj — can you create a 2-step enablement playbook (admin + dev) we can hand to customer success? 3) Tara — one-line exec asks for legal/finance approvals.

mike_cs: Yep — will include a cost delta table. Short note: there's a spike on 2026-02-23 from a batch job; I’ll annotate with action taken.

raj_solutions: Working on playbook. Will include a sample onboarding checklist and a 10-min demo snippet link. Need a screenshot of their console view — @anna_csm can you export?

anna_csm: I’ll export and drop in the drive by EOD today.

lydia_product: One note — upcoming quantization changes may change inference latency by ~5-8% on small sequences. I’ll add a short mitigation note (pin to older runtime if needed).

tara_ae: For exec asks, propose: 1) Approve 6-month reserved capacity pilot for peak windows 2) Fast-track billing review to align commit. I’ll craft language and ping legal if needed.

mike_cs: Action items summary (assignments & due dates):
- MIKE: Slides 1-3 incl. cost delta — due Fri 2026-04-09 EOD
- RAJ: Enablement playbook + demo link — due Mon 2026-04-12 8am PT
- LYDIA: Roadmap impact slide — due Thu 2026-04-08
- TARA: Exec asks + ROI one-liner — due Fri 2026-04-09
- ANNA: Export console screenshot, customer feedback notes — due Thu 2026-04-08

anna_csm: Adding a 'customer voice' snippet: they asked for better observability per-route and clearer cost attribution. We'll include 2 direct quotes in the appendix.

raj_solutions: Noted. Also capturing training request: dev team wants a hands-on session after QBR. I propose a 60-min workshop; can we offer in May?

tara_ae: Yes — include workshop offer as part of exec asks. Good signal for renewal.

ops-bot: Note: Slide freeze reminder in 48 hours.

mike_cs: One more — flagging a potential renewal risk: finance wants clearer unit economics. I’ll add a short appendix with per-feature cost and suggested pricing buckets.

anna_csm: Nice. If we keep this tight we should be able to move Meridian from yellow to green. Quick sync tomorrow 9am PT to review slides before freeze?

tara_ae: 9am PT works for me.

raj_solutions: Works. I’ll have the demo link ready.

lydia_product: I’ll join too.

ops-bot: Meeting created: "Meridian QBR slide review" Tue 2026-04-11 09:00am PT — invite sent to participants.

mike_cs: Thanks everyone — I’ll post the draft slides in the thread when ready for review. :thumbsup:

anna_csm: Thanks — tagging this thread as the canonical QBR workspace for Meridian. Drop slide links and feedback here. :sparkles:
